title: dendranthema horaimontanum
intro: Dendranthema horaimontanum, commonly known as Chrysanthemum, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, headaches, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthemum include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Chrysanthemum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
